description: How each Marketing Engineer run works around the agent: its task definition, weekly schedule, the 14-day window, the outputs and sources its run report accounts for, the records step that saves workspace/ and ledger/ to main, and the prices behind its approximate cost. The launcher reads this file; the agent cannot write it (G8). The exchange with Mandu: docs/mandu-exchange.md. Operating the production clone: docs/operations.md.

schedule.why: The Founder's Mandu sitting is Sunday evening. 16:00 in the Mac's local time zone leaves a few hours to finish, or to re-run on demand, before it.

window.why: Day 1 of the 14-day window and its one fixed evening posting slot (HH:MM, the Mac's local time) are the Founder's call (FR-8), set here through a reviewed change and never inferred. Until day_1 is set, every run prepares calendar days 1 to 7 as the first batch, with no slot; once it is set, each run prepares the calendar days that fall in the week after the coming sitting (the schedule's day), and a post's slot is its date at this time once slot is set too.

records.why: Only the production clone syncs and saves records; every other checkout runs without touching git. Setting sync_before_run or save_after_run to false turns that step off.

cost.why: The run report states the run's approximate cost at API prices from Codex's token counts.
